newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 6.86 percent at Italy BOT buyback.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 6.86 percent at Italy BOT buyback.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 2.0 trillion lire buyback of short term Treasury bills (BOTs) by the Bank of Italy was 6.86 percent compared with 6.76 percent previously, the Bank said.
The average rate was 6.87 percent against 6.82 percent at the previous operation for 2.0 trillion lire on March 5.
The Bank said it received 19 bids of which three were met in full and two in part.
